hostNotes: The shop actually trades as Freshwater Creek Cakes (650 Anglesea Rd, since the mid-1980s) and is famous for its cream sponges, so accept any sponge flavour; the only web-confirmed items are the sponges (incl. gluten-free), sponge/cream kisses, vanilla slice, apple pies, meat and gourmet pies (Moroccan lamb), sausage rolls, quiche, chocolate/lemon/orange/tea/fruit cakes, biscuits, truffles, mince tarts, Zeally Bay sourdough, condiments and ice creams, and everything else in this bank is standard Victorian country-bakery stock included on plausibility at the listed tier. If a player says just 'cake', 'slice', 'bun', 'tart' or 'mince pie', ask them to name the kind before matching, and if they name a slice or biscuit that is not listed, accept it as rare.
